reason: User directed exclusion of beach after reviewing the initial development experiment
role: Adaptive development comparison; not a fresh holdout or production promotion
labelPolicy: Exact inherited consented original full-gold-v1 rows only; no label changes or additional data
implementation: Unchanged phase1 model, training, loss, scaler, decoder grid and evaluator modules; hashes must match parent study
selection: Nested source-group evaluation: outer fits two groups; each inner fit trains on one and validates on the other; select by pooled inner F1_padP_coreR only
joinRule: Positive gaps strictly less than 3 seconds
ignoredRule: Subtract ignored intervals after padding/joining and never rejoin across them
aggregation: Pool durations across recordings within each seed; average separately pooled seed scores for model summaries

feasibilityScreen.coveragePolicy: Report original-rally complete and partial loss identities; no production replacement based on this screen

priorRescorePolicy: A non-beach subset of old predictions is descriptive only: those models still used beach during fitting/selection
runtimePolicy: Architecture unchanged; previous browser graph parity remains engineering evidence, not qualification of the newly trained weights or physical-phone performance
